newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI has no comment on Lonrho talks.
newsitem.headline: JCI has no comment on Lonrho talks.

text.p: JCI Ltd declined to comment on Friday on a Financial Times report saying the South African mining house and Lonrho Plc were preparing to break off merger talks.

The Financial Times, quoting advisers close to JCI chairman Mzi Khumalo, on Friday reported that Khumalo was now close to abandoning talks with Lonrho on the merger which could create a mining house with market capitalisation of $3 billion.
JCI spokesman Marc Gonsalves said the company would not comment on the report, adding: "Not at this stage."
The Financial Times said Lonrho would concentrate on its much-publicised restructuring.
Both companies confirmed last month they were in preliminary merger talks.
JCI shares were unchanged at 36.25 rand in quiet Friday dealings.
